mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 3.0% in the next three months signals labor market strengthening, boosting consumer confidence and equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 0.3pp within the 3-month window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive relative to a baseline period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP (GDPC1) and decline in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) indicates expanding economic activity and accommodative monetary policy, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The combined effect of rising GDPC1 and falling FEDFUNDS does not result in statistically significant positive 60-day returns (p > 0.05), or the interaction effect rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 100.3 signals robust supply-side growth, stimulating demand and equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not sustainably rise above 100.3 over the observation period, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive relative to a baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL below 215 in the next three months signals deflationary pressures, prompting market anticipation of lower inflation and rate cuts, which drives positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not fall below 215 within the 3-month window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP (GDPC1) alongside job growth (PAYEMS) indicates strong demand-side expansion, reinforcing market optimism and generating positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The combined effect of rising GDPC1 and PAYEMS does not result in statistically significant positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05), or the interaction effect rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13155) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 9.5%), elevated equity valuations precede a peak, driving positive 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 13155 and UNRATE < 9.5 in the current month
failure_condition: In the late-cycle regime, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive relative to a baseline period (t-test p > 0.05), or the regime conditions (GDPC1 > 13155 and UNRATE < 9.5) are not met in the current month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) signal robust supply and demand-side growth, amplifying market optimism and generating positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The combined effect of rising INDPRO and GDPC1 does not result in statistically significant positive 60-day returns (p > 0.05), or the interaction effect rank IC falls below 0.03 over the 60-day horizon.
